en_title: Microsoft CEO Says 'Streamlining' at Xbox is 'Great to See' as Layoffs Affect Thousands
subtitle: 重整仍在继续
opus_summary: 微软CEO Satya Nadella表示，XBOX近期裁员及结构调整后的团队精简「令人欣慰」，并计划在下一财年恢复增长。与此同时，黑曜石和贝塞斯达等工作室也受到重组影响。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has spoken about the state of Xbox following layoffs that affected thousands of workers, saying that the "streamlining" at the company is "great to see."
paragraphs.cn: 微软CEO Satya Nadella谈到了数千名员工受裁员影响后XBOX的现状，并表示公司进行「精简」是「令人欣慰」的。

paragraphs.en: The tech executive opened up about how the business' gaming branch is doing during a recent interview on the Sources Podcast with Alex Heath . It's a conversation that followed not only the 1,600 job cuts Xbox delivered in July of this year but also the additional structural changes that were announced just this past week.
paragraphs.cn: 这位科技行业高管近日接受Alex Heath主持的《Sources Podcast》采访，谈到了微软游戏业务的状况。这次对话发生在XBOX于今年7月裁减1,600个岗位之后，而就在上周，微软还宣布了额外的组织结构调整。

paragraphs.en: When touching on Xbox's place under the grander Microsoft umbrella, Nadella said he feels "fantastic" about the IP the brand has in its portfolio and its "ability to take that and produce great games going forward." As layoffs continue to reshape the developers who have made some of those great games, he still seems to be feeling pretty good.
paragraphs.cn: 谈到XBOX在微软整体业务中的定位时，Nadella表示，自己对该品牌旗下的知识产权，以及XBOX「利用这些IP在未来制作优秀游戏的能力」感到「非常棒」。尽管裁员仍在重塑那些曾经制作出优秀游戏的开发团队，但他似乎依然相当乐观。

paragraphs.en: "There's a certain amount of streamlining the team is doing and [Xbox CEO Asha Sharma] is doing, which is great to see," Nadella said in the wake of the most recent cuts. "And then, we have to invent the right sustainable business model that allows us to deliver gaming to more and more people.
paragraphs.cn: 在最近一轮裁员后，Nadella说道：「团队正在进行一定程度的精简，[XBOX CEO Asha Sharma]也在推动这项工作，这令人欣慰。接下来，我们必须打造出正确且可持续的商业模式，让我们能够把游戏带给越来越多的人。」

paragraphs.en: "That has always been the goal, which is, we want to be a great publisher and a great platform provider for games across both PCs and Xboxes. So, that is our goal, and I think Asha and team have said that Xbox is going to get back to growth this next fiscal year, and that's the plan they're executing on, and in that process, do a bang-up job of producing some great games."
paragraphs.cn: 「这一直都是我们的目标：成为优秀的发行商，并为PC和XBOX提供出色的游戏平台。因此，这就是我们的目标。我认为Asha和她的团队已经表示，XBOX将在下一个财年恢复增长，这也是他们正在执行的计划。在此过程中，他们还要努力制作出一些优秀的游戏。」

paragraphs.en: It's optimism that may come as a shock to those who have watched as Microsoft continues to redefine what the Xbox name means by shedding game developers like Double Fine and Ninja Theory and reorganizing beloved studios like id Software . Maybe the most telling sign that the company is entering a new chapter arrived just this past week, when it announced that Halo would be moved from Halo Studios to its Activision teams.
paragraphs.cn: 对于那些一直关注微软如何重新定义XBOX这一名称含义的人来说，这种乐观态度或许令人意外。微软已经裁撤了Double Fine和Ninja Theory等游戏开发团队，并重组了id Software等深受喜爱的工作室。上周，微软宣布将《光环》从Halo Studios转交给旗下Activision团队，这或许是公司进入新阶段最明显的迹象。

paragraphs.en: Xbox announced in July that it could be laying off 1,600 staff, with an additional 1,600 set to follow before the end of the fiscal year. Although this past week offered a closer look at what that long-term plan entails, we won't know the full scope of the company's big "reset" initiative for at least a few more months.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX在7月宣布，可能裁减1,600名员工，并计划在本财年结束前再裁减1,600人。尽管上周公布的信息让外界更清楚地了解了这项长期计划的内容，但至少还要再过几个月，我们才能看到公司这项大规模「重置」行动的全貌。

paragraphs.en: For now, the resulting changes also include the Fallout: New Vegas team at Obsidian Entertainment moving under Bethesda . After State of Decay developer Undead Labs confirmed its independence just days ago, studio head Philip Holt told IGN that the zombie series' third game remains in active development amid its own "significant" wave of layoffs.
paragraphs.cn: 目前，这些调整还包括将《辐射：新维加斯》的开发团队从黑曜石转至贝塞斯达旗下。就在几天前，《State of Decay》开发商Undead Labs确认了自身的独立地位；该工作室负责人Philip Holt告诉IGN，尽管经历了自身「大规模」的裁员，这部丧尸系列的第三部作品仍在积极开发中。

paragraphs.en: For more on how the industry has changed in recent months, you can read about what Nadella had to say about how Xbox's monetization plan at Microsoft compares to YouTube . You can also catch up on what he said about the brand when former Xbox CEO Phil Spencer departed the company .
paragraphs.cn: 想进一步了解近几个月游戏行业的变化，可以阅读Nadella关于微软XBOX变现计划与YouTube进行比较的看法。你也可以了解他在前XBOX CEO菲尔·斯宾塞离开微软时谈到该品牌的内容。
